name: bob-chat
description: Connect Telegram to your AI: read, search and answer your own chats through the BoB Chat phone app. Works with Claude, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients. See linked devices and accounts, list chats, read unread and recent messages, search contacts and message history, send messages, and mark chats read.

interface.longDescription: Connect Telegram to your AI. BoB Chat links your own Telegram account to your assistant: ask what you missed overnight, find a message, or draft a reply. The BoB Chat app on your phone (Android / iOS / macOS) does the work and our server only relays the request, so there are no Telegram API keys and nothing to host. You choose which accounts and chat types (people, groups, channels) the AI can see, and every message it wants to send waits for your tap on the phone. Tools: overview of linked devices and accounts, list and search chats, unread digest, read recent messages, search contacts and message history, send a message, mark a chat as read. Relay results are kept on the server for 7 days, then deleted.
defaultPrompt: Find a contact and send them a message, or summarize my unread chats
